description: A pixel-art dragon on your desktop that mirrors what your Claude Code session is doing, in real time.

python.title: Python command
python.description: How Python 3 is started on this machine. Leave python3 on Linux and macOS; on Windows use py, or python if that is what works in your terminal. The widget needs Python and PySide6, which it fetches once on first use.
